positive_feedback: The step-by-step escalation pathway is easy to follow. Knowing that offline cases are stored and not lost is very reassuring for field use.
improvement_suggestion: It would help to have a simple one-page printed guide of the escalation pathways for health workers without smartphones.

positive_feedback: The safe fallback message is very clear. I understood immediately that the system is asking me to repeat the measurement rather than ignoring the patient.
improvement_suggestion: The dashboard page takes a moment to understand the priority colours. A short legend on-screen would help.

positive_feedback: The separation between HIGH sensor risk with no symptoms and CRITICAL cases where both signals agree is clinically logical. This helps avoid alert fatigue.
improvement_suggestion: The escalation queue shows many queued cases. A visual indicator of how long a case has been queued would improve urgency tracking.

positive_feedback: The conflict detection approach is well-reasoned. Flagging sensor-symptom mismatches for clinician review rather than dismissing them is the correct safety behaviour.
improvement_suggestion: The patient monitoring page could show a small trend chart of BP readings over time rather than only the latest value.

positive_feedback: The workflow is logically structured and clearly documented across phases. The demonstration cases (DEMO001-DEMO006) effectively cover all key scenarios.
improvement_suggestion: The system summary page could include a simple diagram showing how each phase feeds into the next rather than only a text-based workflow.

positive_feedback: The store-and-forward simulation is a good demonstration of offline resilience. The disclaimer labelling is consistent and appropriate throughout.
improvement_suggestion: The conflict cases page could display a count of how many cases were resolved by clinician review versus how many remained open.

positive_feedback: The clinician capacity rule is a practical feature often overlooked in prototype systems. Clearly showing queued cases versus within-capacity cases helps illustrate real-world constraints.
improvement_suggestion: A timestamp or observation day filter on the escalation queue page would make it easier to identify the most recent urgent cases.

positive_feedback: The safe fallback design is the strongest feature. The system never silently classifies an incomplete record as low risk which is an important safety property.
improvement_suggestion: The workflow clarity could be improved by adding short explanatory tooltips next to each metric on the dashboard page.
